notes: A straddle_t 20:00 ET (Tokyo cash open): OCO stop entries at last price +/- offset, cancel unfilled after 60 min, flat 23:59, 1 trade per day; CARD: 20:00 ET all year = one hour AFTER the Tokyo open while the US is on standard time (37 % of the BUILD calendar days) ORCHESTRATOR DECISION 5: 20:00 ET stays 20:00 ET all year (the user's time); the Tokyo cash open is 19:00 ET in the US winter, so the fire is one hour after it then.
rationale: At scheduled liquidity events new orders arrive and price leaves its pre-event balance; a straddle rides whichever side breaks (20:00 ET: Tokyo cash open (19:00 ET in winter: the fire stays at 20:00 ET)).
